description:
A quite basic/generic computer model. The model is split up into a few main parts such as the monitor, keyboard, keys and tower. Currently doesn't have any textures but I've included the Blender file for you to edit. 

The model is free to edit and use in both commerial and personal projects. Credit is not required but greatly appreciated :)
